name: PR detail Files changed tab groups the seeded diff by Smart Diff role
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the Smart Diff grouping renders a role label and a seeded core file (src/middleware/ratelimit.ts). Read-only seeded data (no model call); #482 has no lock file or patch text, so this proves grouping and ordering only, not collapse or the lock-file rule. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
